# lesiw.io

> Plain-text documents about reviewing code, working on Go, and running a
> second agent. Written to be read whole, by a person or an agent.

## Documents

- [Review](https://lesiw.io/review.txt): What to look for in a change, at every
  scale from a concept to a sentence, and the prose rules that go with it.
- [Go](https://lesiw.io/go.txt): A procedure for driving Go code to a clean
  state with lesiw.io/tools, then handing it to a reviewer.
- [Subagent](https://lesiw.io/subagent.txt): How to run a second agent with no
  shared context in a terminal multiplexer, and wait for it without guessing at
  timings.
